lines.hook: Should you drain your phone to zero before charging it? Myth.
lines.memory: Old nickel batteries had a memory effect. Lithium-ion doesn't.
lines.chart: In fact, smaller discharges give it more cycles. About three hundred full drains, versus two thousand if you only use twenty percent at a time.
lines.do: So top up whenever it suits you.
lines.outro: Follow for more battery myths, busted.
